candidates.label: NEUTRAL
candidates.text: Tenant 4 canal boat diary: A painted barge drifted slowly past the willow trees during the golden hour. The crew waved to the walkers. The lamp was left on overnight.

candidates.label: RELEVANT
candidates.text: Tenant 4 circulation note: The note also refers to the cookbook and its renewal. Loans are renewed at the desk. The desk is open until six. Cards are stamped by hand.

candidates.label: COMPETING
candidates.text: Tenant 4 circulation note: The cookbook is the most overdue, 41 days, after a renewal was cancelled. Loans are renewed at the desk. Lost cards are replaced for free.

candidates.label: NEGATED
candidates.text: Tenant 4 circulation note: A renewal makes the cookbook less overdue, due 25 June, not the most overdue. Cards are stamped by hand. Lost cards are replaced for free.

candidates.label: REPEATED
candidates.text: Tenant 4 circulation note: The cookbook is the most overdue, 41 days, after a renewal was cancelled. A further check confirmed the cookbook as most overdue, 41 days.
